programme.notes: DOMAIN: list row has official_domain null; official domain is yonsei.ac.kr. The 2027 international guide PDF is AES-encrypted: the app's pdf_to_text (pypdf without the cryptography package) returns empty text, so quotes from it cannot be verified by verify_evidence; read in the container with PyMuPDF. International freshmen spend the first year in the Global Basic Education Division (GLC) at the International Campus; 'Global Basic Education Division students must achieve TOPIK level 3 or higher to declare one's major'. www.yonsei.ac.kr/en_sc/ returned 404; admission.yonsei.ac.kr main page loads (Korean).

english.notes: No test minimum published. 2027 AY guide (international track, all majors except medicine/dentistry/nursing/pharmacy), language requirement 'Choose One': 'Official documentation proving completion of high school courses conducted in Korean or English', KLI certificate, 'Standardized test result indicating proficiency in Korean or English', 'Korean or English language proficiency test score' - no score stated. Korean (TOPIK 3) is required later to declare a major.

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published in the international guide; document-based evaluation.

deadline.notes: International Student Track, 2027 academic year, SPRING (March 2027) entry; 'All dates and times listed in this guideline are based on Korea Standard Time (KST)'. Already past on the research date. The Fall 2027 round is not yet published (the Fall 2026 round ran '2026. 3. 10.(Tue) 10:00 ~ 3. 26.(Thu) 17:00').
